title: "nerv forget" removes matching rows and names the backup lag
goal: The owner can forget a subject or a date range and is told when the last copy holding it ages out
acceptance: A test shows rows removed from the live database and the printed date equals the oldest kept snapshot or off-host copy plus its retention
The command asks for confirmation and never touches the off-host copies itself
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one command over the T03 per-table rules. Not a measurement.
